Riley (CS): Quick kickoff for Latentia Textiles onboarding. Need owners, measurable success criteria, and a compact 30/60/90.
Priya (Latentia Textiles): Hi all  Priya here. I'll own business sign-off and taxonomy.
Riley (CS): Proposed owners:
- Riley (CS): program lead + feedback capture
- Omar (Solutions): infra, ingest, smoke harness
- Zoe (PM): acceptance testing + metrics
- Priya: business owner, data samples + UAT
Omar (Solutions): I'll aim to deliver a smoke harness and ingest script in 6 business days.
Zoe (PM): Draft success criteria:
1) p95 latency <= 525ms on Dedicated for core lookup flows
2) Top-1 accuracy >= 90% on taxonomy mapping
3) Two engineers can run end-to-end demo by day 12
4) Pilot to 4 stores with zero P1s in pilot window
5) Procurement target cost <= $0.0038 per inference
Priya (Latentia Textiles): We'll provide a 200-row sanitized CSV by Wed; legal will confirm PII clearance. Renewal review scheduled month 11.
Riley (CS): Risks: procurement cost, legal delays, potential need for small fine-tune. We'll surface fallback: route non-critical requests to quantized variant if p95>525ms.
Omar (Solutions): Note: prefer presigned S3 URLs and short-lived creds. I'll share a short ingest snippet once URL is posted.
Zoe (PM): Proposed 30/60/90 milestones:
- 0-30: samples ingest, smoke run, workshop week 2, baseline eval
- 31-60: 4-store pilot, perf tuning, console alerts, cost report v1
- 61-90: expand rollout, stability window, renewal packet prep
Riley (CS): Next steps:
1) Priya uploads sanitized CSV (Wed)
2) Omar runs smoke harness (6 bd)
3) Riley schedules workshop + publishes acceptance checklist (today)
4) Zoe readies nightly eval job and dashboards (week 1)
sched-bot: Calendar invite created: "Latentia Textiles  Redwood Onboarding Workshop" Tue 10:00 PT  attendees: Riley, Omar, Zoe, Priya
Priya (Latentia Textiles): Confirmed  will upload samples this evening. Looking forward.
Riley (CS): Great  I'll post the onboarding checklist link after this thread. Any last items?
Omar (Solutions): All good from infra.
Zoe (PM): Nothing to add.
Riley (CS): Thanks team :rocket:
